# Beatoraja skin compatibility fixtures

`reference_manifest.json` is a clone-independent manifest generated by the
opt-in external audit. It pins the Beatoraja commit, SCURO 4.02 archive and tree
digests, the selected 7-key entry, the opaque audited surface, source-symbol
provenance, and acceptance schema version 1.

No third-party payload belongs in this directory. Lua, images, fonts, audio,
video, or archives added by later tasks must be small, purpose-built,
redistributable synthetic fixtures. The default test hashes every Git-tracked
file and rejects a digest matching any audited external payload, regardless of
filename or extension.

To reproduce the manifest, keep all package material outside the repository
and run:

```sh
python3 scripts/check_beatoraja_reference.py \
  --root /absolute/path/to/pinned/beatoraja --require-clean
python3 scripts/audit_beatoraja_skin.py \
  --beatoraja-root /absolute/path/to/pinned/beatoraja \
  --archive-path /external/path/ModernChic402.zip \
  --archive-package-prefix ModernChic \
  --skin-root /external/path/to/extracted/ModernChic \
  --expected-archive-sha256 06ad5a4c5a1b6d0ece08b79475cbe2b4a5187ce07e490752e141518ee4fcc41c \
  --verify tests/fixtures/beatoraja_skin/reference_manifest.json
```

The real paths above are examples only. Never record an absolute local path in
the manifest, docs, reports, or committed evidence.
